hero.sub: Everything you need to know about your devices, shipping, returns, and more.

items.a: Netherlands: 2–3 business days. EU: 3–7 business days. International: 7–14 business days. You'll receive tracking via email once your order ships.

If you don't see visible improvement within 30 days of consistent daily use, contact us for a full refund. No lengthy process, no pressure.

items.q: How do I return a product?
items.a: Email info@zentialpure.com with your order number. We'll approve your request within 24 hours and provide a prepaid return label.
For hygiene reasons, opened consumables (gels, pads) cannot be returned. Devices can be returned in original packaging within 30 days.

items.q: Can I use the devices daily?
items.a: Yes. Our devices are designed for daily use in 5-minute sessions. Start at the lowest intensity and gradually increase as your skin adjusts.
For microcurrent devices, a conductive gel or water-based serum is essential for optimal current delivery and skin protection. Our Collagen Face Gel is formulated specifically for this.

items.q: How long until I see results?
items.a: Most users notice improved skin texture within 2 weeks. Structural changes (lift, definition) typically become visible after 3–4 weeks of daily use.

items.q: Can I use multiple devices together?
items.a: Yes, our devices are designed to complement each other. Use them in sequence as part of your daily ritual for enhanced results.
Yes. All devices use clinically-studied technology with multiple safety features. Always follow the included ritual guide and start at the lowest setting.

items.q: Who should not use these devices?
items.a: Do not use if you have a pacemaker, are pregnant, have epilepsy, active skin infections, or metal implants in the treatment area. Consult your physician if uncertain.

items.q: Is it safe for sensitive skin?
items.a: Yes. Start at the lowest intensity. If irritation persists beyond mild initial redness, reduce frequency and consult a dermatologist.
Microcurrent delivers low-level electrical stimulation that mimics your body's natural bioelectric currents, activating facial muscles and stimulating collagen production.

items.q: What does red light therapy do?
items.a: Red light (620–660nm) penetrates the skin to stimulate cellular energy production, supporting collagen synthesis and reducing inflammation.
Electrical Muscle Stimulation uses targeted pulses to contract and tone facial muscles, similar to a workout for your face.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, iDEAL, Bancontact, Klarna, Shop Pay, Apple Pay, and Google Pay. All transactions are securely processed.
Yes — Klarna is available at checkout, allowing you to split your purchase into interest-free installments.
